svg.title: Agentic SDLC workflow with task-to-skill ownership and evidence-guided failure routing
svg.desc: A readable top-to-bottom map of the Agentic SDLC golden path. Every numbered task names its owning skill. A separate conditional failure map shows classification, troubleshooting, corrective planning, revalidation, design admission, and precise stop branches. Every arrowhead tip touches its destination boundary.
svg.text: Follow the numbered golden path. The skill pill in every card names the owner of that task.

g.text: Create or resume the integration worktree.
Write failing or already-green tests at HEAD.
Isolate workers; integrate in dependency order.
Build, parse, lint, type, and review boundaries.
Observe the user-visible or system-visible flow.
Refresh user-facing docs from proven behavior.
Reconcile requirements, design, code, and proof.
Commit once; ff-only promote the exact SHA.

svg.text: 4 · VERIFY AND RELEASE THE EXACT PROMOTED HEAD
Missing decisive evidence · competing hypotheses · incomplete diagnosis · environment / permission / policy / human decision
Exhausted budgets · same blocker after design remediation · semantic A→B→A cycle · phase churn without new evidence
BUDGETS: ≤2 localized · ≤1 design · ≤3 total per blocker tranche · ≤60 active minutes · every retry needs new evidence + a falsifiable hypothesis
Private evidence: failure events, diagnoses, classifications, repair control, journal, failure log, and checkpoints.
Acceptance criteria never weaken to make a repair pass.
